mobileCopilot.expoPort.description: Port where the Expo Metro dev server runs (for Expo Go QR code).

mobileCopilot.autoStart.description: Automatically start the mobile server and connect to relay when VS Code launches.

mobileCopilot.sessionTimeout.description: Session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

mobileCopilot.relayUrl.markdownDescription: WebSocket URL of an external relay server (e.g. `wss://gopilot-relay.onrender.com`). Used when `transportType` is `relay`.

mobileCopilot.transportType.markdownDescription:
Transport layer for mobile ↔ extension communication.
- **relay**: WebSocket relay hub (requires `relayUrl`).
- **pubsub**: Google Cloud Pub/Sub (serverless, requires `pubsub.projectId`).

mobileCopilot.pubsub.projectId.markdownDescription: Google Cloud project ID for Pub/Sub transport. Required when `transportType` is `pubsub`.

mobileCopilot.pubsub.topicName.markdownDescription: Pub/Sub topic name. The topic must exist in the configured project.

mobileCopilot.pubsub.subscriptionName.markdownDescription: Pub/Sub subscription name for the extension to pull from (mobile → extension messages).

mobileCopilot.pubsub.mobileSubscriptionN.markdownDescription: Pub/Sub subscription name for the mobile app to pull from (extension → mobile messages). Included in pairing info.

mobileCopilot.captureMode.markdownDescription:
How to capture Copilot Chat responses for the mobile client.
- **relay**: Augments the prompt asking Copilot to write its response to a temp file (deterministic, proven).
- **interceptor**: Monitors document change events to detect chat responses (experimental, no prompt pollution).
- **hybrid**: Tries interceptor first, falls back to relay if no chat text is captured.
